home.heroTitle: Professional Car Diagnostics with Artificial Intelligence
home.heroSubtitle: Turn your smartphone or PC into a powerful scanner. Read errors, analyze live data, and get step-by-step repair instructions from AI.
home.feature1Desc: Not just error codes. Our AI translates complex DTCs into human language and suggests probable breakdown causes.
home.feature2Desc: Real-time monitoring of all car sensors. Beautiful charts and analysis right during your drive.
home.feature3Desc: Support for ELM327 adapters (USB, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi). Works with most modern vehicles.
home.step1Desc: Plug the adapter into your car's OBD-II port.
home.step2Desc: Connect to the adapter via AutoScan.
home.step3Desc: Explore the AI report on your car's condition and errors.
home.ctaDesc: Join the platform and save on trips to the mechanic.

cookieConsent.title: We use cookies and similar technologies
cookieConsent.summary: We use essential cookies to run the site (for example, login and security). With your permission we may use additional cookies for analytics and marketing.
cookieConsent.euNote: If you are in the European Economic Area or UK, we only enable non-essential cookies after you opt in. You can change your choice at any time.
cookieConsent.usNote: If you are in the United States, including California, you can limit certain uses of personal information as described in our privacy notice. See also the option below regarding sale or sharing.
cookieConsent.necessaryDesc: Required for basic site operation, authentication and security. These cannot be turned off.
cookieConsent.analyticsDesc: Helps us understand how the site is used (for example, aggregated visits).
cookieConsent.marketingDesc: May be used to measure campaigns or show relevant content on our or partners’ properties, where applicable.
cookieConsent.saleOptOutDesc: Signals that you opt out of the sale or sharing of personal information for cross-context behavioral advertising where this choice is recognized under US state laws (for example, California).
